title: Samia & Iris
description: Iris and Liam were the perfect couple until Liam accused her of cheating on him. Iris suspects Samia, her rival, of orchestrating this breakup.

questions.question: Samia must be talking about me behind my back... Can you find out exactly what she calls me?
That's what I thought. Can you check when their last joint training session was for Liam and her?
He accused me of cheating on him the next day, I don't believe in coincidences... Did she tell him something about me? Find out what she talked about.
So she did tell him about me. Why did she do that, what is she trying to achieve?
What a pest! I'm not sure this message is enough to make Liam believe in my innocence. Tell me if she's already gone after someone else. Can you give me a first name?
questions.hint: Instagram — see Samia's bio with the emoji 🦊, then look at the stories where you can see a locker tagged with a fox

questions.question: She's so out of line. But she's not supposed to have access to other people's lockers. Who gave her the locker codes?
What is Sofia's locker code?
questions.hint: Photos — photo of locker codes showing code C147 for Sofia

questions.question: I'm sure she took advantage of it to scheme something. Does anyone else know that she opened the lockers? If so, who?
A secret... Interesting. What is she hiding?
questions.hint: WhatsApp — conversation with her mom, then Spotify — see the podcasts

questions.question: I didn't know... But that doesn't justify her dirty tricks. What exactly did she steal from Adam?
questions.hint: Snapchat — in the My Eyes Only gallery

questions.question: But what's in this photo? It must be super important for Adam to threaten her like that.
Samia told Liam that I was cheating on him but I'm certain: I never kissed Adam! If it's a photo of a kiss between him and me, it must be a deep fake. Tell me who's in the photo.
questions.hint: Hidden Photos — the code can be found in Notes ('Photo code = 🐶's birthday'), and the dog's birthday is on Instagram

questions.question: What... No... I can't believe it? That's not possible? A kiss between Adam and Liam??? When was this photo taken?
questions.hint: Hidden Photos — look at the date displayed on the photo

questions.question: This is so humiliating... Why did Liam hide this?
questions.hint: Gmail — email from Stan mentioning Mr. Klein and the national ballet selection, then Instagram — conversation with Sofia

questions.question: He's using me as a cover, is that it? Tell me how long has Samia known about their relationship? I need to know the whole truth
questions.hint: Snapchat — conversation with Adam, look at the date of Samia's message

questions.question: I feel sick... They're all just as hypocritical as each other. Give me their next joint training date. With Liam, Adam and Samia. I'm going to confront them with their lies

textSuccess: I feel sick... They all manipulated me. Liam used me as a cover, Adam was complicit, and Samia orchestrated everything. I'm going to confront them tomorrow at rehearsal. This time, I'm going to take back control. Thank you for helping me discover the truth, even though it hurts.

onboardingContent.text: My name is Iris, you don't know me but I really need help. I'm living a nightmare right now.
My boyfriend Liam left me a few days ago. He's accusing me of cheating on him with someone... but it's not true! I'm sure that Samia is behind all this.
Samia, my rival since high school. She's always been jealous of me and now she's managed to destroy my relationship. I have to prove that she's manipulating everything!
I got hold of her phone while she was distracted. Help me search through it to find evidence of what she did. Please...

messages.text: Samia, I hope you're doing well
yes I'm fine prof! and you?
I have important information to pass on to you
meeting in 2 days for the last rehearsal before the audition. Pass the info to all the others.
11:00 sharp, in the main rehearsal room
This is very important, this rehearsal will determine your participation in the final audition
of course! who exactly should I tell?
Perfect. All be on time and in full costume
Don't forget your new pointe shoes
ok I'll mention it to the others
Very good. I'm counting on you for this information relay
Thank you Samia. See you Thursday then
By the way, prepare yourselves mentally
sweetie did you eat lunch today?
that's not enough for a dancer
what time are you coming home tonight?
tomato basil sauce like you like it
and how did your class go?
good! prof Moreau told us about Thursday's rehearsal
a little but it'll be fine
yeah and you? still doing your pointe work?
actually I have a big rehearsal this week
by the way what are you doing this weekend?
we could hang out if you want
I'd love to! Saturday afternoon work for you?
Hi Samia! Tomorrow's appointment still on?
Perfect. We're working abs this time
It's for your own good! A dancer needs a strong core
especially since I have my audition soon
Oh yeah that's right! Are you ready?
You're gonna crush it I'm sure 💪
hey thomas! it's been a while
we should meet up one of these days
Hello Samia, sorry about the noise last night
Good! It was my son and his friends
By the way, your dance classes are going well?
hey samia! did you finish your report?
you want to do it together?
good idea! does Sunday work for you?
I'll pick you up by car then 😎
haha can't wait to see that
hi sarah! I'm good and you?
yes of course! and you still in London?
Could you come visit me someday?
Perfect! Let me know when you're free
my sister told me you dance really well
she says you're going to audition
samia do you have the notes from french class?
can you send them to me please?
of course! I'll scan them for you tonight
no problem! by the way what are you doing after class?
we could go grab a coffee
hey lucas! I'm good how about you?
awesome! what are you up to?
and I'm skateboarding at the park
cool! be careful not to wipe out
Hello, I'm downstairs at your building for the delivery
Hello Samia! Your pointe shoes have arrived
perfect! I'll come pick them up tomorrow
Did you see the class this morning?
She put herself right in the middle again, total NPC
always putting herself front and center that girl
like she's the star of the group
I could use your help. Could you stop by my office later?
I have some administrative documents to photocopy. There's notably the list of student locker codes.
No problem, I can do that
But it's confidential okay. Especially don't take any photos, this is sensitive data.
Yes yes of course, no worries
I trust you. Come by around 2pm, I'll leave the documents on my desk.
Look what I found while tidying up
Do you see the calendar behind?
You weren't even one year old
We could already tell you'd be a dancer
I love you so much sweetheart
Did you take your epilepsy medication this morning?
I worry about you, you know
Even if you don't want your teacher and classmates to know about your epileptic seizures, I hope you brought your medication with you today, Samia
I love you so much too sweetheart
Girl I have something crazy to tell you
You know the thing I took from Adam's locker?
I have to give it back to him but I kept a copy 😏
Is it really a kiss between Adam and who I think ??
You've got what it takes to cut her down to size 😈
Don't worry, I hid the photo in my hidden photos
what are you doing this weekend?
We're gonna work on abs as a priority
our french teacher from middle school
she asked how you were doing
tell her i think about her too
if you run into her again
I have a package for you
I'll come pick it up this afternoon
you coming to the skate park tomorrow?
i'd love to but i have class
Do you have the notes from yesterday's class?
i'll send them to you by email
samia did you read the book for tomorrow?
it went okay in the end
Ready for the English test tomorrow?
i'll come pick them up tomorrow
Your Uber Eats order will be delivered in 15 minutes

emails.subject: You know very well what I'm talking about
emails.body: I know it was you who stole it from my locker, you sneaky snoop. You better give it back to me if you don't want me to spill your secret. You can kiss goodbye to your spot in the national ballet.

emails.subject: Exceptional visit - National Ballet Selection
emails.body:
Dear students,

I hope you are all doing well and that your training is going smoothly. I am writing to inform you of an exceptional opportunity that has come our way.

Don't forget that in 3 days, we will have the honor of welcoming Mr.Klein for the detection of young talents. He will select one boy and one girl to join the national ballet.

I encourage you all to give your very best during this visit. This is a unique chance to showcase your talent and dedication to this magnificent art.

Sincerely,
Stan Moreau
Classical Dance Teacher

Thank you very much,
Samia Amari
